resources.string: LastScroll observes tap and scroll events, app window changes, and volume key presses, only within the apps you select and only while a sleep timer is running. It uses them only to reset or pause the sleep timer, and to go home and lock the screen when the timer expires. Nothing is stored or transmitted.

LastScroll watches for taps, scrolls and volume presses only in the apps you choose, and only while a timer runs. It uses them only to reset the timer and to turn the screen off when time is up.\n\nNothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Shows when the screen will turn off, with a button to cancel.
Lets LastScroll notice taps and scrolls in your chosen apps and turn the screen off when time is up.
If Android says the app was denied access: tap Open app info, tap the three-dot menu at the top right, tap Allow restricted settings, then come back and tap Grant accessibility permission again.
No Allow restricted settings in the menu? Tap LastScroll in the Accessibility list once first, then check again.
